authorization_sequence: human review of scientific lock candidate
commit and push approved scientific prestructure lock
while structure remains blinded create and statically validate exact execution implementation
materialize and hash complete annotation-only comparator matrix
separate human review and explicit approval of committed PRESTRUCTURE_IMPLEMENTATION_LOCK
only then may structure_test_authorized become true

provenance_description: PRE-STRUCTURE BASELINE RE-ESTABLISHMENT AFTER PRIOR BASELINE INSPECTION

annotation_only_controls.name: unique_kmer_fraction
annotation_only_controls.source: Ensembl 91 validated transcript FASTA and src/exact_kmers.cpp
annotation_only_controls.definition: canonical ACGT-only distinct 31-mers unique to one transcript identity divided by all distinct valid canonical 31-mers

annotation_only_controls.name: unique_kmer_fraction_missing
annotation_only_controls.definition: 1 when raw value is absent or non-finite, else 0
annotation_only_controls.rationale: retain inability to define exact 31-mer uniqueness

annotation_only_controls.name: unique_exonic_bases
annotation_only_controls.definition: exonic bases in segments belonging to no other same-gene transcript

annotation_only_controls.name: shared_exon_fraction
annotation_only_controls.rationale: fractional exon sharing and assignment ambiguity

annotation_only_controls.name: unique_junction_count
annotation_only_controls.definition: adjacent junction coordinate pairs occurring in exactly one same-gene transcript

annotation_only_controls.name: max_exon_jaccard
annotation_only_controls.definition: maximum exonic-base intersection/union with another same-gene transcript

annotation_only_controls.name: identical_splice_chain_isoforms
annotation_only_controls.definition: same-gene isoforms including self with identical ordered intron chain

annotation_only_controls.name: incidence_rank_deficiency
annotation_only_controls.source: Ensembl 91 exon-segment plus junction incidence matrix and existing SVD tolerance
annotation_only_controls.definition: number of transcript columns minus numerical matrix rank

annotation_only_controls.name: mean_exon_length
annotation_only_controls.definition: transcript exonic length divided by exon count
annotation_only_controls.rationale: read-support geometry beyond total length and exon count

annotation_only_controls.name: miniquant_kvalue
annotation_only_controls.source: original miniQuant c1b5a89f3c31c83b271a477475a1e289ee9806d7 gene K-value; fragment length 235; effective-length entry; two threads; Ensembl 91 GTF
annotation_only_controls.definition: original miniQuant gene K-value mapped many transcripts to one gene value
annotation_only_controls.rationale: published annotation/read-model conditioning control distinct from exact k-mers and exon incidence

annotation_only_controls.name: miniquant_kvalue_missing
annotation_only_controls.definition: 1 when raw value is absent or non-finite, else 0
annotation_only_controls.rationale: retain K-value availability without treating absence as an ordinary K-value

excluded_annotation_candidates.name: genomic_span
excluded_annotation_candidates.reason: intronic span is not a direct transcriptome-identifiability control after transcript construction

excluded_annotation_candidates.name: repeat_content
excluded_annotation_candidates.reason: not implemented and no authoritative repeat-mask release is pinned

excluded_annotation_candidates.name: incidence_condition_number
excluded_annotation_candidates.reason: singular matrices create non-finite values; incidence_rank_deficiency encodes the locked failure mode

annotation_matrix_materialization.identifier_join: apply src/rnaobs/core.py stable_id rule that removes the terminal numeric transcript version while preserving _PAR_Y; require one-to-one frozen stable_id rows
required_before_any_structure_file_acces: materialize from only pinned Ensembl 91 and pinned miniQuant resources and implementations without structure or outcome inputs
restrict to the frozen ordered 15999-transcript cohort
verify exactly one row per frozen transcript
include every locked added annotation control
commit or hash the matrix through a deterministic artifact or receipt allowed by repository policy in PRESTRUCTURE_IMPLEMENTATION_LOCK

prestructure_implementation_lock.name: PRESTRUCTURE_IMPLEMENTATION_LOCK
hard_guards: rerunning a consumed locked model attempt without adjudication
permitted_static_validation_without_real: bootstrap logic tests on synthetic data
permutation logic tests on synthetic data
commit_must_contain_or_hash_at_minimum: materialized annotation matrix or deterministic artifact or receipt according to repository policy
prestructure_implementation_lock.approval_to_authorization_transition: only a separately committed, pushed, reviewed, and human-approved PRESTRUCTURE_IMPLEMENTATION_LOCK may permit structure_test_authorized to become true

structure_source.biological_context: K562; pooled processed in-vivo scores from a different study and preparation than SG-NEx
structure_source.score_interpretation: unbounded per-position icSHAPE enrichment/accessibility proxy; not probability, truth, or causal exposure

required_checks: unique source stable ID in Ensembl 88
processed reported length equals Ensembl 88 transcript length

assay_quality_controls.name: callable_fraction
assay_quality_controls.definition: count of finite non-NULL per-position scores divided by reported transcript length

biological_structure_features.name: median_reactivity
biological_structure_features.definition: NumPy float64 median of all finite non-NULL per-position GSE132099 enrichment scores for the uniquely mapped transcript; arithmetic mean of the two middle sorted values for an even callable count

structure_parsing_and_missingness.median_algorithm: numpy median float64; arithmetic mean of two middle sorted values when callable count is even
structure_parsing_and_missingness.partial_callability: exclude NULL positions from median and denominator; retain callable_fraction as assay quality

preprocessing.added_annotation_source: pinned Ensembl 91 resources and locked implementations

feature_transformations_before_scaling.independent_abundance_log1p: consume stored natural log1p value without re-derivation

fold_local_imputation.strategy: NumPy float64 median of finite training-fold values, including arithmetic mean of two middle values for even count

scaler.constant_column_behavior: retain; sklearn maps centered constant to zero

estimator.test_behavior: apply training imputation medians and training scaler unchanged
estimator.prediction_tie_break: lexicographic class name among maximum probabilities

primary_comparison.hypothesis: D_STRUCTURE provides joint held-out incremental information over C_QUALITY
primary_comparison.formula: macro_f1(D_STRUCTURE pooled OOF) - macro_f1(C_QUALITY pooled OOF)
primary_comparison.paired_evaluation_unit: same frozen transcript rows with same held-out folds
primary_comparison.class_imbalance_treatment: unweighted macro average across all five fixed classes; zero_division=0
primary_comparison.fold_aggregation: pool all five OOF folds once; do not average fold metrics

bootstrap.sampling: sample 4314 cluster IDs with replacement and include all rows in every sampled cluster
bootstrap.statistic: macro_f1(D_STRUCTURE) - macro_f1(C_QUALITY) on identical resampled rows
bootstrap.missing_class_draw: retain all five labels and assign absent-class F1 zero
bootstrap.interpretation: conditional on fitted OOF predictions, frozen groups, and observed preparations; not biological-replicate uncertainty

permutation_negative_control.assignment: independently permute source cluster IDs within each stratum and assign complete ordered vector to target cluster
permutation_negative_control.fit_behavior: refit D_STRUCTURE on all five frozen folds for every permutation; reuse observed C_QUALITY OOF predictions
permutation_negative_control.test_statistic: permuted D_STRUCTURE pooled macro_f1 - observed C_QUALITY pooled macro_f1
permutation_negative_control.missingness_pattern: preserved; primary biological feature must be complete
reported_quantities: 95th percentile using numpy quantile method linear
permutation_negative_control.pass_rule: observed delta strictly greater than permutation 95th percentile

secondary_metric_definitions.corrected_log_loss: negative mean natural log of max(named actual-class probability, 2.220446049250313e-16)
secondary_metric_definitions.accuracy: number of correct predictions divided by number of transcripts
secondary_metric_definitions.balanced_accuracy: unweighted mean recall across the five fixed classes
secondary_metric_definitions.brier_multiclass: mean across transcripts of sum across five ordered classes of squared probability minus one-hot outcome
secondary_metric_definitions.confusion_matrix: rows observed and columns predicted in fixed class order

sensitivity_analyses.name: stricter_callability_0_75
sensitivity_analyses.folds: original frozen fold labels; no regeneration
sensitivity_analyses.uncertainty: same 5000-draw paired sequence-cluster bootstrap with seed 20260924 on surviving clusters
sensitivity_analyses.reason: test robustness in a more completely observed assay subset using a threshold documented before structure-outcome testing
sensitivity_analyses.interpretation: conditional robustness only; not a better target population

multiplicity_policy.primary_hypothesis: joint D_STRUCTURE model increment over C_QUALITY in pooled OOF macro_f1
multiplicity_policy.reason_no_correction: there is one primary hypothesis and no secondary inferential family
multiplicity_policy.permutation_treatment: calibration of the same primary comparison, not a separate hypothesis

practical_effect_thresholds.rationale: macro-F1 averages five class F1 values; 0.020 requires a total 0.10 class-F1 increase, while a sub-0.005 gain is too small for a biological increment claim in this imbalanced workflow-specific setting

gates.validity: all locked artifacts, mapping, features, fits, probabilities, negative controls, and mandatory sensitivity complete without unresolved blocker or deviation

ordered_rules.if: validity and positive and statistical and practical and null_calibrated and fold_robust and callability_robust and class_stable
validity and delta_macro_f1 >= 0.005 and null_calibrated and callability_robust and number_of_fold_deltas_strictly_positive >= 3 and (statistical or practical) and not SUPPORTED

partial_support_interpretation.SMALL: eligible only if permutation calibration passes, strict-callability delta is positive, at least 3 of 5 fold deltas are positive, and paired bootstrap CI lower bound is above zero
partial_support_interpretation.MEANINGFUL_WITH_CI_TOUCHING_ZERO: eligible only if permutation calibration passes, strict-callability delta is positive, and at least 3 of 5 fold deltas are positive
partial_support_interpretation.class_instability: does not invalidate a completed analysis; can downgrade SUPPORTED to PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED if every partial gate passes and must be prominently named as a deficiency

IMPLEMENTATION_REPAIR.definition: correct code that demonstrably fails to implement an unambiguous locked rule without changing any scientific or statistical choice
requirements: rerun every affected hierarchy model and downstream statistic from clean derived outputs
human adjudication before rerun if performance was visible

PROTOCOL_DEVIATION.definition: any change to source identity, mapping, cohort, feature list/order, threshold, transformation, missingness, comparator, model, hyperparameter, fold, seed, thread rule, metric, resampling, sensitivity, decision rule, or claim boundary
requirements: deviated analysis cannot silently replace locked primary

events: any primary-cohort structure missingness or callability failure

protocol_deviation_rules.reanalysis_allowed: only for adjudicated implementation repair or explicitly labeled protocol deviation; never silently and never selected by performance

stop_rule.after_scientific_lock_approval_commit_an: STOP; next phase is PRESTRUCTURE_IMPLEMENTATION_LOCK, not Model D execution
stop_rule.after_implementation_lock_commit_and_pus: STOP for separate human review and explicit approval before any structure access

claim_boundaries.SUPPORTED: Within the frozen, structure-callable SG-NEx K562 transcript cohort and named Salmon 1.9.0/Ensembl 91 workflows, pooled GSE132099 K562 in-vivo icSHAPE median enrichment provided a meaningful, held-out incremental association beyond the locked abundance, sequence, annotation-identifiability, and assay-callability comparator. The result is cross-study, conditional, predictive, and non-causal.
claim_boundaries.PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: Within the frozen workflow-specific cohort, the locked structure model showed limited evidence of incremental predictive information. The effect was at least SMALL, exceeded the negative-control 95th percentile, remained positive under stricter callability, and was positive in at least three of five folds, but it did not meet every SUPPORTED gate. Name the unmet statistical, meaningful-magnitude, four-of-five-fold, and/or class-stability gates explicitly, and report any DIRECT_RNA_ONLY or INDETERMINATE class-instability flag prominently.
claim_boundaries.NOT_SUPPORTED: The locked development analysis did not support an incremental contribution of GSE132099 median icSHAPE enrichment beyond the strongest locked non-biological comparator for this workflow-specific conditional estimand. The null or negative result is retained as a scientific result, not described as pipeline failure.
claim_boundaries.INCONCLUSIVE: The locked development analysis could not yield a valid conclusion because a prespecified data, mapping, model, negative-control, sensitivity, convergence, or protocol-integrity requirement failed. No direction of biological structure contribution is inferred.
mandatory_visible_limitations: historical numerical environment not exactly recoverable
original historical transcript-level predictions not recoverable
aggregate historical agreement does not establish original prediction identity
bootstrap conditional on fitted OOF predictions and sequence clusters
shared preparation and workflow specificity limits

longbench.eligibility_considered_only_after: development conclusion and execution artifacts are frozen, committed, human-reviewed, and explicitly approved
can_validate: transport of the fixed workflow phenotype and fixed model in a distinct sequencing context, subject to an approved compatibility audit
